Malayalam Classic 'Thenmavin Kombathu' Re-released in 4K

The 1994 Malayalam film 'Thenmavin Kombath' has been re-released in theatres in 4K Dolby Atmos format. The re-release occurred on October 1, 32 years after its initial debut. The film is known for its iconic dialogues, including 'Ask me who I am.'
